dependency_constraints.source: readme:README.rst: installable via 'pip install astropy'; PR#16964 concerns astropy.stats biweight_location, biweight_scale, biweight_midvariance

numerical_failure.observed_behavior: biweight_location returns an array with the wrong shape when the input has length 1 along an axis not included in the axis keyword (e.g. arr of shape (5,1,4,10) with axis=-1 returns shape (5,5,4) instead of (5,1,4)); and for constant data with axis set to a tuple of all axes it returns np.float64(nan). The same len-1-axis shape bug is also reported for biweight_midvariance and biweight_scale.
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: The returned shape should match the reduced shape (e.g. (5,1) for arr of shape (5,1) reduced over axis=-1 with shape (5,1,4,10) giving (5,1,4)), and for constant data with axis=(0,1,2) on np.ones((5,1,10)) the result should be 1.0 instead of nan.
trigger_conditions: input array has axis length 1 along any axis not included in the axis keyword
axis is a tuple containing all axes and the data is constant
axis=None with constant data is handled correctly in the same fix (not the failing case)
oracle_clues: val.shape should equal (5, 1) / (5, 1, 4) per PR comments
biweight_location(arr, axis=(0,1,2)) should be 1.0 for constant data
regression tests added in the fix commit (not quoted in passages)

numerical_characteristics.magnitude: constant data with value 1.0 (ones arrays); no other magnitude regime stated
category_specific_evidence: Violated shape property: with arr = np.ones((5, 1)), biweight_location(arr, axis=-1).shape returns (5, 5) but should be (5, 1)
Violated shape property: with arr = np.ones((5, 1, 4, 10)), biweight_location(arr, axis=-1).shape returns (5, 5, 4) but should be (5, 1, 4)
Violated constancy property: for constant data np.ones((5, 1, 10)), biweight_location(arr, axis=(0, 1, 2)) returns np.float64(nan) but should be 1.0
Implied property: for constant data the biweight location should equal the constant value; the fix also covers biweight_scale and biweight_midvariance axis-length-1 shape handling
Regression tests parametrize shapes (5,4,3), (5,1,3), (1,4,3), (1,1,5) for 3D axis tests and (2,3,4), (12,1,2), (1,12,2), (1,1,24) for tuple-axis tests
test_biweight_location_constant asserts val == 1.0 for biweight_location(np.ones((10, 5))) and with axis=(0, 1)

Changelog 16964.bugfix.rst states the shape bug affects biweight_location, biweight_scale and biweight_midvariance when an axis length is 1 along a non-reduced axis, and NaN for constant data with axis tuple of all axes
reproduction_risks: Shape bug is triggered only when an input axis of length 1 is not included in the axis keyword
NaN bug is triggered for constant data when axis is a tuple containing all axes
Randomized tests use NumpyRNGContext(12345) with np.random.normal, so random-data reproductions depend on that seed
Exact dtype and tolerance for the assertions are not stated beyond assert_
